# Hexagonal Architecture & Port-Adapter Decoupling

Strict hexagonal layer decoupling: domain core contains zero framework imports, ports define interfaces, adapters handle external I/O.

## Invariants
- DOMAIN_CORE_HAS_ZERO_EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES
- DEPENDENCIES_POINT_INWARD_ONLY
- INPUT_VALIDATION_AT_PRIMARY_ADAPTERS
